title: Users
description: DataViews user list with bulk delete-and-reassign and self-delete guard.

documentation.purpose: DataViews table of WordPress users with permanent bulk delete (content reassigned to the acting user). Lists name + username, email, roles, and registered date. Search hits name + email. Filter by role. The DataViews `RenderModal` for the destructive action ships a self-delete guard that strips the acting user from the target set before issuing the REST call.

reads.purpose: Resolved DataView doc — fields, default view, default layouts, actions. Read via `useDataView(screenId)`; baseline ships in `app.json#dataView` (with variants family) and is injected post-merge by `inject_app_baselines`.
User rows in the DataViews table. `context: 'edit'` is required for email + roles to be present.

Per-role totals for the roles filter elements ("Editor (3)"). One lightweight request per role value via `useEntityElementCounts`; role values come from the resolved spec elements, so the count set tracks whatever roles the shell exposes.
Identify the acting user so self-delete is blocked + content reassignment target is set.

writes.purpose: Bulk-delete users permanently with content reassigned to the acting user (`force: true, reassign: currentUserId`).

states.renders: Table of users with Delete bulk action.
Confirm modal. Copy varies by target count and whether the acting user is in the selection.

states.when: Modal opened but `targets` is empty after self-filter
states.renders: Cannot-delete-yourself message; destructive button is disabled.

interactions.effect: Open confirm modal with copy adjusted for target count + self-skipped marker.

Filter out the acting user, dispatch `deleteEntityRecord` per target with `{ force: true, reassign: currentUserId }` via `Promise.allSettled`, `invalidateResolution` on the user query, success snackbar on full success; partial-failure error notice surfaces the failed/total counts.
Local `view` updates; queryArgs recomputes; records refetch.

a11y.focus-management: DataViews owns focus inside the table + modal.

constraints.note: Without `context: 'edit'` the response omits email + roles.
Filter out `window.wpAdminWorkspaces.userId` before sending REST. Reassign-to-self fails server-side and the bulk request errors silently mid-flight.
WordPress has no user trash. Delete is permanent; the `reassign` parameter is mandatory or content with `post_author = id` is orphaned.
Call `invalidateResolution('getEntityRecords', ['root', 'user', queryArgs])` — the per-row `deleteEntityRecord` does not bust the parent query.

Fields / actions / defaultView / defaultLayouts ship as the manifest baseline. admin.json `settings.dataViews.root.user._default` wins on whole-entry override; the per-triple filter `wp_admin_workspaces_data_view_config_root_user[_<variant>]` runs last. Render callbacks (name cell, modal body) stay in `index.js` keyed by spec id.

design-system-leakage.purpose: DataViews + DataForm components, field descriptor shape. Table view with selection + bulk action.
Destructive primary action — WPDS 0.12 has no `tone="critical"`.
Delete row action icon. Resolved via the kernel icon registry by spec id (`spec.icon: "trash"`).
